args: media loop --help
Set loop/repeat mode

[1m[32mUsage:[0m [1m[32mwayle media loop[0m [32m<MODE>[0m [32m[PLAYER_ID][0m

[1m[33mArguments:[0m
  [32m<MODE>[0m
          Loop mode

          Possible values:
          - [1m[32mnone[0m:     No looping
          - [1m[32mtrack[0m:    Loop current track
          - [1m[32mplaylist[0m: Loop entire playlist

  [32m[PLAYER_ID][0m
          Player identifier (number or partial name match)

[1m[33mOptions:[0m
  [1m[32m-h[0m, [1m[32m--help[0m
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
